taskSettings.title: Task types & priorities
taskSettings.levelsHint: Switch extra levels above epics on for this project. The hierarchy is theme → initiative → epic → story → task → subtask; a level can only be switched off while no tasks of that type exist.
taskSettings.prioHint: The built-in priorities are always available. Project admins can add more; a custom priority can only be deleted while no task or template uses it.
taskSettings.estimationHint: Choose how this project estimates effort. Off by default — pick a unit and every task gains an estimate field in it. Switching units keeps the values you already entered; they are simply hidden until you switch back.
taskSettings.boardLaneHint: How many cards a board lane shows at once. The rest load as you scroll, so a long lane stays quick to open. This only changes how much is drawn — every task stays on its lane and the lane's count always shows the full number. Set 0 to show everything.
